description.short: Search and read your Kube entities, officers and the records held on them.
description.full: Connect Microsoft 365 Copilot to your Kube corporate-registry and entity-management platform, published by Kuberno. This agent lets Copilot search and read your organisation's entities and officers, along with the records held on them — an entity's or officer's appointments, roles, contacts, addresses, alternates and user defined fields, an entity's compliance dates, meetings, registrations and activities, and an officer's committees and external appointments — scoped to what your Kube user is permitted to see. It is strictly read-only and honours Kube's per-user access permissions and field-level redaction.
